Poor quality for the price
Jun 2015 • Couples
Let me start of by saying the venue is nice with brightly lit large skycraper windows (of course!). Good street view. That being said, it can get hot if you want to sit next to the windows on a sunny day. It is modern, clean and service was good. They keep the place neat and tidy. Most of the food was fair. They have a nice selection of options, but nothing fancy or unique to that buffet chain. There were some really good dishes like seafood salad, lemongrass steam mussel and other seafood items. However, most meat dishes were overcooked and/or dry. The oysters were not very appetizing. It seems that some dishes were cooked long before they brought it for serving. For around $25-30 per person, I expected better quality and bigger selection. In my opinion, I do not know because we went there on a Sunday and it was packed, but nevertheless, I can get better lunch for that price in Saigon.

reviews.review_text:
Emma Nhu N

Let's hope that you like having dinner at 4pm and that you can eat very fast
Mar 2015 • Family
because otherwise, you won't get much out of your dining experience at this restaurant. We arrived at 6:30 pm and the food was half-gone. The crab was gone for good and most of the food was served lukewarm. There are 4 choices for ice-cream but only 2 were edible if you like melted ice-cream. Service was mediocre; I had to asked 4 times for refill of my water and plates were being clean very slowly. The only highlight of the meal was the freshness of the shrimps and oysters. The atmosphere was very crowded and stuffy. For almost 600,000 VND, I could have dined at a smaller but more elegant and delicious restaurant (private message for suggestion). Even though Hoang Yen's menu is big, most of the dishes were very mediocre and half-heartedly prepared. For example: the Kimchi chicken stir fry, I could only find bony pieces but not any meaty ones. Fried rice was soggy and overdosed with ketchuo. And most of the fried food were very dry and cold. I would definitely not come back to this restaurant and not recommend anyone to try it. If you are a traveller and want to try Vietnamese food, buffet is never a good way to go, you risk being sick and will not learn anything properly about Vietnamese cuisine. For the Vietnamese looking for a quality premier buffer dinner, this is definitely not recommended, please feel free to contact me for suggestion.

Great buffet but poor good service
Oct 2013 • Friends
Visited Hoang Yen Buffet Premier restaurant located at Bitexco Centre in the heart of District 1 as invited by some close friends for a party of seven.

Entrance was spartanly decorated and have no entry statement at all .. Was lead to our seating and given wine list which was not elaborate and delightful enough so we chose a bottle of Pinot Noir from Argentina which turn out being below average .. Pretty acidic without the fruity and rich aroma scent.
The buffet spread was not well spreaded out in a orderly way and at the end of the kitchen was the all time favourite BBQ seafood but the waiting time for them to cook your selected food was so long that you loose your interest in no time so I abandon the queue n go look for other spread which was not really impressive as the display was not artistically done. I had to open ten dishes cover just to find two palatable Vietnamese food and the Japanese section looks cold and tired which turn you off 
Dessert selection was usually nice with some delightful fruits and local bean curt red bean platter probably as a desperate attempt to appease unhappy customers at the Q line..
Will not probably return as HCM has other choices with better options for the prices this restaurant is charging..
